item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Learn2Zinc: Fine-tuning Small Language Models for Text-to-Model Translation in MiniZinc
item.description: Researchers fine-tuned small language models to generate MiniZinc code, achieving 98% execution accuracy through error-correction training, though constraint reasoning remains challenging.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Dropping the Anchor: Statistical Context Summarization for Distributed Systems via Pulsar Attention
item.description: Pulsar Attention improves long-sequence LLM inference efficiency by 3.3x using content-aware context summaries instead of static anchors.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] CAMeR: Keyword-Gated Hybrid Activation for Adaptive Memory Retention in LLM Agents
item.description: CAMeR combines symbolic and embedding-based gating with adaptive decay to improve memory retention and retrieval efficiency in LLM agents over extended dialogues.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] THOR: A Theta-Gamma Hierarchical Oscillatory Reasoning Framework for Multi-hop QA
item.description: THOR, a brain-inspired framework using Theta-Gamma oscillation, addresses attention decay and error accumulation in multi-hop question answering, improving accuracy and robustness.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Instruct-FD: Can Your Full-Duplex Speech System Follow Turn-Taking Instructions?
item.description: Instruct-FD benchmark reveals full-duplex speech systems struggle to follow turn-taking instructions, with best model achieving only 64.4% adherence to controllable dialogue behaviors.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Can Valence Reflect Morality in Natural Language? A Preliminary Annotation Study
item.description: Study finds emotional valence in text predicts moral classification with 0.764 correlation, suggesting affect is relevant to AI ethics.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Evaluating the Effectiveness of Persona Simulation in Opinion Prediction with GPT-4.1
item.description: GPT-4.1 persona simulation predicted election outcomes in eight of nine states and vaccine opinions at 0.94 accuracy, showing promise if bias is addressed.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Frontier Financial Judgement: Can agents tell what might move a stock?
item.description: New benchmark tests AI agents' ability to identify stock-moving financial information, finding best agent matches expert accuracy only 52.4% of cases.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] From Agent Failures to Text Policies: What Works and What Breaks
item.description: Research finds TextGrad cannot reliably learn agent policies from trajectories, though human policies work, indicating learning is the bottleneck.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Learning to Detect UI Principle Violations via Reinforcement Learning
item.description: A 4B vision-language model trained with reinforcement learning achieves 84% accuracy detecting UI principle violations in LLM-generated web interfaces.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] REGARD: Regional Affective Differences in Large Language Models
item.description: Study analyzes 19 LLMs' affective responses to post-Soviet entities using Valence-Arousal-Dominance profiling, identifying three behavioral clusters by emotional arousal levels.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Rushes: A Human Preference Dataset for Pluralistic Alignment
item.description: Rushes dataset shows frontier LLMs fail to match baselines in predicting personalized user preferences in interactive narratives.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Are Diversity Metrics Measuring Diversity? A Capability-Controlled Audit of Majority-Vote Gain in LLM Ensembles
item.description: Diversity metrics for LLM ensembles primarily track model capability rather than independence, with voting rarely outperforming the strongest member alone.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] The Geometry of Personality: Activation Steering with Jungian Cognitive Functions
item.description: Researchers introduce Jungian Cognitive Functions framework for controlling LLM personality via activation steering, revealing structured geometric patterns in neural representations.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] REFACT: Adaptive Fact Restatement for Compact and Faithful Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
item.description: REFACT trains LLMs to adaptively ground reasoning steps with source facts at varying granularities, improving faithfulness and token efficiency.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] CSPF: A Constrained Shared-Private Fusion Method for Non-Verifiable Preference Evaluation
item.description: CSPF improves non-verifiable task evaluation by fusing multiple reward models through decomposed shared-private representations, surpassing single-expert and scalar-score baselines.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] LegalCiteTrust: Benchmarking Citation Trustworthiness in Chinese Long-Form Legal Research Reports
item.description: Researchers benchmark citation trustworthiness in LLM-generated Chinese legal reports, finding that improved retrieval doesn't guarantee reliable source citation.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Tencent WorkBuddy Bench: A Multi-Domain Coding-Agent Benchmark with Contamination-Resistant Task Construction
item.description: Tencent releases WorkBuddy Bench, an open-source multi-domain coding-agent benchmark built from real commits and pull requests with contamination-resistant task design.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] From a Word-Level Dictionary to Sentence-Level Semantics: Multilingual Grievance Labelling with Contextual Models
item.description: Contextual language models better detect grievance in multilingual text than word-level lexicons by accounting for context including quotes, negations, and implications.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Where Animacy Lives in Large Language Models: Tracing the Circuits of the Animacy Concept
item.description: Researchers identified a distributed animacy circuit in language models that distinguishes animate from inanimate concepts but varies across models.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] CultureTalk-ID: A Multi-Task Dialogue Benchmark for Cultural Commonsense in Indonesian Local Languages
item.description: CultureTalk-ID introduces a dialogue-based benchmark with 4,496 conversations across Indonesian and 10 local languages to evaluate cultural commonsense in language models.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Sample-Efficient Learning from Agent Experience
item.description: Researchers develop Experience Distillation method enabling agents to retain 64.8% of in-context learning gains while requiring 9.6x fewer environment samples than classical RL.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] QuantiBias: Benchmarking Quantization-Induced Bias in LLMs
item.description: Quantized language models exhibit measurably increased bias in open-ended generation despite passing standard safety checks, researchers find via QuantiBias benchmark.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] PrefReward: Learning User Preference Matrix for Personalized Text Generation
item.description: PrefReward models user preferences through a structured matrix to guide personalized text generation, outperforming baselines in quality and interpretability.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] One More Turn, Less Regret: A Regret-Based Multi-Turn Benchmark for LLMs' Clarification Policies
item.description: Researchers introduce RegretBench, a benchmark evaluating LLM clarification policies in multi-turn conversations through regret-based metrics and semantic-state tracking.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Progressive Cramming: Reliable Token Compression and What It Reveals
item.description: Progressive cramming reveals perfect reconstruction of compressed token sequences doesn't preserve model capabilities, suggesting fundamental limits to compression beyond optimization.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] slang.gr as a Large-Scale Crowdsourced Resource for Non-Standard Greek
item.description: Researchers map Greek slang.gr crowdsourced lexicon using multi-layer taxonomy and community-based confidence scores for definitions to enable sociolinguistic NLP analysis.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] A Comparative Evaluation of Embeddings and LLMs in a Greek Book Publisher Setting - The CUP Dataset
item.description: CUP benchmark evaluates retrieval methods for Greek books, finding hybrid retrieval performs best overall while multilingual embeddings outperform language-specific models.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] A Unified Moral-Value Dataset for Instruction Tuning
item.description: Researchers unified moral-value datasets for instruction tuning to align LLMs with human values while maintaining general task performance.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] news-crawler-LM: A Small Long-Context Model For High-Quality News Crawling
item.description: news-crawler-LM is a small language model fine-tuned for extracting structured content from news pages, outperforming baseline methods with lower computational cost.

item.description: DataPrep-Bench introduces the first unified benchmark for evaluating LLM-driven data preparation capabilities including data construction and quality evaluation.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] PhantomFill: When the Form Demands an Answer, Language Models Invent One
item.description: Required form fields cause language models to hallucinate answers instead of admitting insufficient information.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] The Active Ingredient in Muon's Grokking
item.description: Muon optimizer reaches grokking threshold faster than AdamW due to orthogonalization via Newton-Schulz iteration rather than spectral-norm constraints.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Scaling Closed-Loop Feature Channel Configuration with LLMs
item.description: LLMs optimize neural network channel widths at scale, achieving better accuracy and parameter efficiency on CIFAR-100.
